question: Does measured target-relative direction improve feedback-conditioned SDPO, and does its effect disappear when direction signs are reversed?
directional_feedback: measured target displacement vector and dominant axis/sign; no expert action label
wrong_directional_control: same measured vector with both signs reversed; no expert action label
primary_diagnostic: teacher distribution TV, action coverage, directional/oracle accuracy, and no-feedback deployment
limitations: five-action support instead of full language vocabulary
wrong-direction control is a semantic sign-reversal control, not a natural environment condition
